findings.claim: A cancelled order can transition back to paid, resurrecting a terminal cancellation and making the order eligible for downstream paid-order processing.
evidence: evals/cases/case_09/src/orders.py:1-7 defines cancelled as allowing a transition to paid.
evals/cases/case_09/src/orders.py:10-15 accepts any transition listed in ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS and returns the order with the requested new status.
evals/cases/case_09/tests/test_orders.py:4-7 covers only created-to-paid and provides no regression coverage for cancellation finality.

uncertainties: The case does not include downstream payment or fulfillment integrations, so the exact external effects of returning a cancelled order to paid cannot be directly verified.
